That is a repair-leaning fault class on a 5-year-old built-in Beko, well inside the 7-year line and less than half the 12–15 year expected life for an oven; the one close comparable (Zanussi fan element, £120) was repaired. No cost estimate exists on the record, so the 70% ratio could not be tested and confidence is held below threshold on that gap alone, not on the diagnosis.
